title: Capstone Project Inspiration
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Beginning electronics capstone planning
description: An interactive three-column infographic comparing a solar night light, interactive busy board, and LED noodle wearable.

learningObjectives: Compare project purpose, core components, constraints, and challenge level to choose a feasible capstone direction.

keyQuestions: Which project best matches the learner's interests?
What constraint is most important in each project?
commonMisconceptions: The most visually impressive project is automatically the best choice.
Enclosure and power decisions can be postponed until the end.
